proportionDraft.generationPrompt:
Edit the full-body turnaround in Image 1 for an animation production model. Deliver one polished, clean, landscape full-body turnaround of the SAME young adult man. Image 2 is the user's chosen head turnaround: keep the drawing of each of those heads, hair, warm open brown eyes, straight resting lips, jaw shape and age. Image 3 is an underdrawing of the new joint heights and sensible figure proportions. Use its three body axes and horizontal landmarks underneath the clothed characters; omit construction marks from the final.

Make a visible anatomical correction: in Image 1 the mass of hair/head is oversized on narrow shoulders and the middle neck is elongated. Scale each whole head including hair to about 85% of its old size relative to body height, keeping the internal face proportions from Image 2. About 6.6 standing head heights counted from the highest hair tuft to the chin; a lean young adult with functional shoulders, not a fashion model. Keep enough mass at the shoulders, ribcage and pelvis to support the head and the crossbody bag, with a natural compact neck. Chin sits clearly above the scarf, just a short strip of bare neck above the clavicles. The profile ear sits above the shoulder and the side neck tapers naturally into the trapezius. Give the profile ribcage real front-to-back depth under the same worn cloak. Three equally scaled orthographic rotations: front left, true side facing screen right in center, exact back right. Align all three crowns, chin/eye levels, shoulder joints, elbows, belt/hip, knees, ankles and boot soles. Slight relaxation of arms, wrists about hip-joint height, fingertips midway down upper thighs. Hips to soles approximately half of standing height. Set the feet under the hips supporting his weight, knees unlocked, distribute weight evenly. No heroic V shape, short legs, oversized boots, long neck or lanky stretched limbs.

Use the same specific indigo asymmetrical weathered cloak, grey scarf down at the neck, diagonal strap, fingerless gloves, forearm wraps, cloth satchel on the man's right hip and small rectangular card case on his left hip exactly as in Image 1; keep the items on the same anatomical sides through rotation. Same quiet mauve ground, soft diffuse light, matte two-dimensional animation with restrained flecks of color, same adult expression as Image 2. Keep the original small bottom labels “正面”, “右侧面”, “背面”, ample padding for crown and soles, 1586 by 992 canvas. No diagram, ruler, guidelines, text other than those three labels, portrait inset, or extra figures.

imageGen.headTurnaroundPrompt:
Identity-preserving edit of the supplied character portrait. Make a wide horizontal animation model sheet of THREE matching head-and-shoulder views on the same dusty grey mauve ground. Use this uploaded artwork as the sole model. Rotate this particular painted young man's head. Its proportions, expression, palette, highlights and layered brown hair tufts are already decided.

Left third: reproduce the submitted FRONT PORTRAIT at matching proportions and color, eyes looking straight at the viewer. There is no design change to this view. Center: a strict 90-degree orthographic right-facing profile of that same head, only one eye visible. Right third: exact straight-back view, ears and nape visible under the layered hair, no cheek. All three columns have the same scale, crown line, eye height and chin height. Leave a little quiet margin above the tallest hair tufts, show hair, entire face, neck, and the settled loose taupe scarf around collarbones with indigo cloak just entering at the bottom. Sheet aspect ratio about 2.74:1. Even thirds. No words, borders, dividers, inset, logos, or other elements.

Specific recognizable features from the portrait: the tousled high crown with one curved cowlick and broad overlapping featherlike locks sweeping asymmetrically across his brow, open almond eyes with large warm brown irises visible and the soft space above the upper eyelid, broad relaxed eyebrows, the gently rounded nose tip, warm ochre cheeks and youthful gently tapered jaw ending in a soft rounded chin, closed lips with flattened corners, a faint cupid's bow and a slightly full lower lip. Eyes, mouth and ears sit at the same vertical levels after rotation. The side view has softly recessed lips below the nose, the upper lip nearly aligned with the lower and the jaw naturally tucked back. This is a quiet, alert early-twenties survivor. Match the restrained, matte 2D game shading and small irregular color planes of the reference. Keep all scarf fabric below the neck and every facial landmark plainly visible, keep the expression calm.

No figures, text, markings, horizons, lines or new imagery. Keep brightness and hues of the reference. The existing selected character drawings will be placed separately in production.

imageGen.prompt: Localized silhouette tailoring edit for the fictional young survivor's existing three-view game art sheet in the attached image. Return the same wide, opaque, full-body front / right-facing profile / back orthographic model sheet, same positions and grounded soles. Change only two proportions by a small amount. Lengthen the legs about three per cent from the hip to the soles, distributing the extra length between thighs and lower legs, leaving boots at their actual size and on the original ground line. Let the whole torso with its head travel upwards slightly; keep the physical size of each approved head completely consistent. Make the shoulders in the front and back views about four per cent broader through the outer shoulder caps and the way the indigo cape falls, roughly five pixels outward on either side at this sheet's size. Feather the effect into the sleeves above the elbows and the clavicles below the low grey neck scarf. Keep the middle view an exact right-facing side projection, with consistent leg length. Preserve the current lean young build, all facial features and hair, waist, original shoulder-strap and card case, draped indigo fabric, boots, straight poses, original small Chinese captions and the softly textured mauve ground. No framing change, new items, diagrams, highlights or extra details. A restrained revision by the original artist.
